free_tier.stated: Tresorit Basic: 3 GB of encrypted storage, free with no expiring trial and no credit card; uploads up to 500 MB per file, sync across 2 devices and up to 10 encrypted links per month.
free_tier.notes: https://tresorit.com/pricing/personal lists paid plans only: Personal Lite 50 GB, Personal Essential 1 TB and Personal Pro 4 TB, each with a 14-day trial for which payment information is required.

reliability_note: Personal Lite plan provides 50 GB storage with a 2 GB maximum file size and 2 GB link sharing allowance. Business plans start at significantly higher monthly rates.
confidence_note: Rejection quoted from historical research records; unverified against live endpoints.
